# SoilSidekick Pro / LeafEngines

> Agricultural intelligence platform providing USDA soil data, EPA water quality, AI crop recommendations, carbon credit estimation, satellite vegetation monitoring, and a developer API (LeafEngines) for any US county.

SoilSidekick Pro is the consumer/grower product. LeafEngines is the underlying API and SDK suite used by enterprise, OEM, and agtech partners. The platform supports offline operation via WebGPU local LLMs and a QGIS plugin for GIS workflows.
